games.name: [🐟] Fisch
games.desc:
🦈 Welcome to Fisch 🦈

Dive into Fisch, the ultimate fishing adventure where exploration and progression are yours to control. Cast your line to catch rare and unique fish, each with 400,000+ possible variations. Explore a growing world with your trusty rod, and maybe even reel in some new friends along the way!

[How To Fish]
• Hold down [LMB] to cast your bobber
• Await a bite. You can "shake" your rod to attract fish faster
• When you have a bite, hold down or click [LMB] to pull the bar white bar. Follow the blue line to the best of your ability; it's okay to mess up a few times!
• When the progress bar on the bottom is full, you'll reel in your catch!

games.name: DON'T BLINK
games.desc:
👁️ DON’T BLINK is a 1vAll or 2vAll survival horror game inspired by Doctor Who, where survivors must escape deadly Angels and survive until the round timer ends.

As a survivor, you MUST control your blinks, keep your eyes on the Angels, and never look away at the wrong time. Every blink gives them a chance to move closer. Survive the round before they reach you.

As an Angel, you must wipe out all the survivors before the timer runs out.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: THIS GAME IS NOT FOR SALE. BEWARE OF PEOPLE IMPERSONATING ME OR PRETENDING TO OWN THE GAME.
